notes.title: Horizon's Mirage is OUT Now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, hope you are doing well. 
After a lot of long nights, hard work and commitment Horizon's Mirage is out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/02fb87833c25edac49ac737ca09bafdbf3ea21b5.png
So what is Horizon's Mirage?

 It is a single-player atmospheric platformer, that takes place in a deserted cityscape. After you start new game, you will find yourself in this desolated city, filled with all kinds of anomalies and dangers, while being prompted to reach the enormous holographic statue at the end to escape.

 A long the way there are these things called ability points, that can be collected. After a few collected you can start unlocking powers, through the ability stations, such as: Double Jump, Slide, Air Dash, Time Reduction (slow motion) and Elevation (jetpack)

 Play slow or fast. There is no timer or other things that are rushing you. Reach the checkpoints without falling or getting hit by some hazard.

 The game does not punish you, by making you lose progress with the collected points, when you die before reaching a checkpoint. Once you have collected an ability point it is yours. The checkpoints are also at a fair distance.

 Horizon's Mirage is not designed to be a VR game. Although I have seen to be played as one with third party programs. Maybe it will be in VR one day, only time will tell.


What to know and what's next?

 Don't forget to leave a review! The most important thing Post-launch is the review count.

 If you have played the demo, I recommend starting a new game.

 Will continue to update the game with bug fixes, improvements and maybe new features.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/77eb799d34d4919b49e5d3cf99528254b02ab8b8.png
Game settings
The game has variety of options to tweak.

 Field of view (FOV)
 Motion blur
 Graphics preset
 Anti-Aliasing Method
 Frame rate limit

 Character mesh skin customization
 Character mesh visibility
 Head bobbing (Camera shake)

 Full remappable key buttons (Keyboard and mouse)
 Full controller support

 Full localization in 8 languages


Launch trailer
[previewyoutube=90Lqfk0gcno;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2579510/Horizons_Mirage/

notes.title: Horizon's Mirage - Version 1.0
notes.content:
Hey everyone, great news: Horizon's Mirage just hit version 1.0 and its ready to release! It's been quite an exciting journey, filled with long nights, hard work and commitment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/cf5f28b5da03b24973aec0dd79308a146166d491.png

About the game 
Horizon's Mirage is an atmospheric first-person platformer set in a deserted cityscape where all kinds of anomalies and dangers await. Explore and search for ability points to unlock powers like slow motion, jetpack, air dash and more.

Gameplay
You are trapped in a deserted cityscape, filled with all kinds of anomalies and dangers, thus have to reach the holographic statue to escape, which is at the other side of the city.
Game paced:

 Game pacing
Play slow or fast. There is no timer or other thing that rushes you. Reach the checkpoints and try not to fall or get hit by some hazard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/11d0825e7b49aa1bdc8d304a03f7862ff8668774.png
 Unlock ability powers
After a few collected points you can start unlocking powers through the ability panels. There are no limits on how much powers the player can use. Total of 5 ability powers: Slide, Double Jump, Air Dash, Time Reduction (slow motion), Elevation (Jetpack). Each ability costs different amount of points.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/735b5cc97827ae67b2a560f299fc9b42a29b8643.png

Release date
The game is set to launch November 4, 2024
Even though the game is finished, it will continue to receive updates for improvements, bug fixes, etc. after the release.

Recent updates

 Added camera bobbing (shake) for the idle, walk and sprint state for the character.
 Added skin color customization for the character.
 Added UI for the ability powers with cooldown.

 Improved visuals.
 Improved VRAM usage.
 Improved ladder climbing.

 Implemented achievements.
 Added support for 8 languages.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2579510/Horizons_Mirage/

notes.title: First Playable Demo
notes.content:
Hello future urban explorers!

You can now get a taste of the game by playing the free demo here on steam.

[previewyoutube=oGlok4JfiH0;full][/previewyoutube]

About the game:
Horizon's Mirage is a exhilarating first-person parkour set in a modern cityscape surrounded by skyscrapers. Progress through checkpoints, conquer dynamic obstructions, explore alternative paths and gather collectibles to unlock time reduction, air dash and more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/bdb43e7b4833ea499fc4470da8f0d1975e34484f.gif
The gameplay revolves around precise timing, reflexes, and spatial awareness.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/9ddfe3530c6dfb2e8d98f6fb84c0f5b029a5b493.gif

As you sprint, leap and teleport through the city's landscape, you'll encounter various hazards and dangers. From gaps between buildings to shifting holograms, tower cranes, wrecking balls and all kind of obstructions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/8d3889a0396469fc16f3fbcf0660d9d039cf1fe5.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/2c8af4cce1719f4ad1298d138a0572b048598b10.gif

While the primary goal is reaching the checkpoints, players will discover alternative paths that lead to valuable collectibles. These collectibles contribute to unlocking new skills such as time reduction (slowing time), double jump, air-dashing and slide, enhancing your parkour abilities, and granting access to previously inaccessible areas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/03b328a525a9c68fbaf0b70e53f49630137b190c.gif

notes.title: Time Reduction Ability
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=8wJirZE4Vi0;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello everyone and welcome to the first post of Horizon's Mirage! I have created a time reduction ability (slowing time) It works close to a slow motion, but the player's perception is not affected as much, allowing him to move quicker, more accurate and dodge obstructions easier.

The time reduction ability can be unlocked like many other abilities with enough gathered points. The points are all over the map, some of them require the player to take more risky and dangerous path to reach it.
